```{r setup, include=FALSE}
pmx_shared <- function(f) {
  root <- Sys.getenv("PMX_ROOT", "")
  cand <- c(file.path("_shared", f), file.path("..", "_shared", f),
            file.path("..", "..", "_shared", f),
            file.path("02_html", "_shared", f),
            file.path("analyses_template", "_shared", f))
  if (nzchar(root))
    cand <- c(cand, file.path(root, "_shared", f),
              file.path(root, "02_html", "_shared", f),
              file.path(root, "analyses_template", "_shared", f))
  hit <- cand[file.exists(cand)]
  if (!length(hit))
    stop("shared fit template not found: ", f,
         "\n  looked in: ", paste(cand, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  hit[1]
}
knitr::knit_child(pmx_shared("fit_setup.Rmd"), quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r figure-layout, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(pmx_fit_caption_style)
```

```{r switches}
RUN_BOOTSTRAP <- FALSE   # non-parametric bootstrap CI (nlmixr2extra::bootstrapFit)
RUN_SCM       <- FALSE   # covariate search (nlmixr2extra::covarSearchAuto)

BOOT_NBOOT   <- 200      # replicate fits: each one is a full refit
BOOT_CI      <- 0.95     # two-sided level -> percentile CI at 2.5 % / 97.5 %
BOOT_STDERR  <- "perc"   # "perc" = percentile interval, which makes no symmetry
BOOT_STRAT   <- NULL     # optional stratification variable, e.g. "DOSE"
BOOT_RESTART <- FALSE    # TRUE discards the cache and starts the run over

SCM_SEARCH  <- "scm"     # "scm" = forward + backward, or "forward"/"backward"
SCM_PVAL    <- list(fwd = 0.05, bck = 0.01)   # pre-declared significance levels
SCM_RESTART <- FALSE     # TRUE discards the cache and starts the search over
SCM_MAP <- list(
  tvvc = c("BW", "SEX"),
  tvcl = c("AGE", "BW", "SEX", "RACE", "CRCL")
)
SCM_CAT <- c("SEX", "RACE")
```

# Dose levels are text ("10 mg/kg", "100 nmol"), so the default alphabetical
# order puts 10 before 3. The numeric part decides the order instead.
dose_fct <- function(x) {
  u <- unique(as.character(x))
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^\\s*([0-9.]+).*$", "\\1", u)))
  factor(as.character(x), levels = if (all(!is.na(n))) u[order(n)] else sort(u))
}

# 1. Data Overview

```{r read-data}
df <- read.csv("ppk_data.csv", na.strings = ".")
obs <- df %>% filter(EVID == 0)
dose_rec <- df %>% filter(EVID == 1)

cov_tab <- df %>% distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

summary_tab <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Subjects", "Total records", "Observations", "Dosing records",
             "Dose groups (mg)", "Subjects per dose group", "Cycles",
             "Median BW (kg)", "% Female"),
  Value = c(
    nrow(cov_tab),
    nrow(df),
    nrow(obs),
    nrow(dose_rec),
    paste(sort(unique(cov_tab$DOSE)), collapse = ", "),
    paste(sprintf("%s: n=%d", names(table(cov_tab$DOSE)),
                  as.integer(table(cov_tab$DOSE))), collapse = "; "),
    length(unique(df$ADY)),
    round(median(df$BW, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    round(100 * mean(df$SEX == 2), 1)
  )
)
kable(summary_tab, caption = "Dataset Summary", align = "lc")
```

## 1.1 Covariate Summary

```{r cov-summary, results='asis'}
cov_df <- df
con_cov <- c("AGE","BW","BMI","ALB","CRCL")
cat_cov <- c("SEX","RACE","DOSE")
var_labels <- pmx_fit_covariate_labels(c(AGE="Age",BW="Body weight",BMI="BMI",
  ALB="Albumin",CRCL="Creatinine clearance",SEX="Sex",RACE="Race",DOSE="Dose level"))
cov_table <- pmx_patient_characteristics(cov_df,con_cov,cat_cov,var_labels,
  level_display=pmx_fit_level_display,id="ID",label_column="Covariates")
pmx_fit_characteristics_kable(cov_table)
```

## 1.2 Concentration-Time Profiles (Spaghetti)

```{r spaghetti, fig.width=10, fig.height=5, fig.cap="Individual concentration-time profiles"}
obs_dose <- obs %>%
  select(-AMT) %>%
  left_join(dose_rec %>% distinct(ID, AMT), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(DOSE_LBL = factor(paste0("Dose: ", DOSE),
                           levels = paste0("Dose: ", levels(dose_fct(DOSE)))))

ggplot(obs_dose, aes(TIME, DV, group = ID)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ DOSE_LBL) +
  labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "Concentration (ng/mL)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## 1.3 Concentration-Time by Dose (Summary)

```{r conc-summary, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Mean concentration-time profiles by dose group"}
obs %>%
  group_by(DOSE, TIME) %>%
  summarise(
    GeoMean = exp(mean(log(DV), na.rm = TRUE)),
    N = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(TIME, GeoMean, color = dose_fct(DOSE))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "Geometric Mean Concentration (ng/mL)",
       color = "Dose (mg)") +
  theme_bw()
```

# 2. Model Fitting

```{r fit-knobs, include=FALSE}
FIT_FAM      <- "ppk"
FIT_SEC      <- c(save = 3, boot = 4, scm = 5)
FIT_CTL      <- "base_model.ctl"
FIT_THETA    <- c("TVVC", "TVCL", "TVKA1", "TVKA2", "TVALAG2", "TVF1")
FIT_ETA      <- c("ETA_VC", "ETA_CL", "ETA_F1")
FIT_REFIT    <- FALSE

FIT_ENDPOINT <- function(m) model(m, {
  conc <- f
  conc ~ prop(sdRes)
}, append = TRUE)

FIT_PREP <- function(df) df %>%
  transmute(id = ID, time = TIME, evid = EVID, amt = AMT,
            cmt = ifelse(EVID == 1, CMT, 3), mdv = MDV,
            dv = ifelse(EVID == 1, NA, DV), dvid = 1L,
            eps1 = 0, eps2 = 0)
```
